meta.title: Consuming Darkness – 2
meta.description: Capturing, consuming, eradicating... the collapsed star shall be as a shroud upon the universe.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: Hss—
units.displayText: Hss—

spans.text: Hss—

units.rawText: The plasma saber impales yet another Low-Order Entropic as Xinghuan pilots her exo in a winding course on the edge of the base.
units.displayText: The plasma saber impales yet another Low-Order Entropic as Xinghuan pilots her exo in a winding course on the edge of the base.

spans.text: The plasma saber impales yet another Low-Order Entropic as Xinghuan pilots her exo in a winding course on the edge of the base.

units.rawText: I can't believe they forced me to the hangar elevator... I hope Yuwang's made it back to Jupiter safely.
units.displayText: I can't believe they forced me to the hangar elevator... I hope Yuwang's made it back to Jupiter safely.

spans.text: I can't believe they forced me to the hangar elevator... I hope Yuwang's made it back to Jupiter safely.

units.rawText: Warning, body has sustained heavy damage. Neural Strain Index is rising. Seek medical attention.
units.displayText: Warning, body has sustained heavy damage. Neural Strain Index is rising. Seek medical attention.

spans.text: Warning, body has sustained heavy damage. Neural Strain Index is rising. Seek medical attention.

units.rawText: Yeah right, as if I have the luxury of treatment given the circumstances.
units.displayText: Yeah right, as if I have the luxury of treatment given the circumstances.

spans.text: Yeah right, as if I have the luxury of treatment given the circumstances.

units.rawText: Alerts pop up all over her field of vision to the point where Xinghuan begins to feel her visual modules starting to lag. She starts to see double when she looks at the two charging spaceships and the broken-down escape pod in the corner.
units.displayText: Alerts pop up all over her field of vision to the point where Xinghuan begins to feel her visual modules starting to lag. She starts to see double when she looks at the two charging spaceships and the broken-down escape pod in the corner.

spans.text: Alerts pop up all over her field of vision to the point where Xinghuan begins to feel her visual modules starting to lag. She starts to see double when she looks at the two charging spaceships and the broken-down escape pod in the corner.

units.rawText: Oh? Not running any more? Have you given up at last, or do you have some other trick up your sleeve?
units.displayText: Oh? Not running any more? Have you given up at last, or do you have some other trick up your sleeve?

spans.text: Oh? Not running any more? Have you given up at last, or do you have some other trick up your sleeve?

units.rawText: I know what you're thinking. How shall I put this... You're... buying time, right?
units.displayText: I know what you're thinking. How shall I put this... You're... buying time, right?

spans.text: I know what you're thinking. How shall I put this... You're... buying time, right?

units.rawText: Nothing to say? Which means I guessed it, right? Ahahahahaha! Well, what else would you have expected of me? I can see right through this sort of thing without even trying.
units.displayText: Nothing to say? Which means I guessed it, right? Ahahahahaha! Well, what else would you have expected of me? I can see right through this sort of thing without even trying.

spans.text: Nothing to say? Which means I guessed it, right? Ahahahahaha! Well, what else would you have expected of me? I can see right through this sort of thing without even trying.

units.rawText: Where it's hidden?
units.displayText: Where it's hidden?

spans.text: Where it's hidden?

units.rawText: <size=40>—AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!</size>
units.displayText: —AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!

spans.text: —AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!

units.rawText: Caina approaches the ship, step by step. Xinghuan can do nothing but open fire...
units.displayText: Caina approaches the ship, step by step. Xinghuan can do nothing but open fire...

spans.text: Caina approaches the ship, step by step. Xinghuan can do nothing but open fire...

units.rawText: Bangbangbangbang!
units.displayText: Bangbangbangbang!

spans.text: Bangbangbangbang!

units.rawText: Ahaha, you're mad, I'm right!
units.displayText: Ahaha, you're mad, I'm right!

spans.text: Ahaha, you're mad, I'm right!

units.rawText: Her bullets are once again repelled by that invisible force before they can touch Caina. They stop in mid-air, then turn around and fly toward Xinghuan at high speeds.
units.displayText: Her bullets are once again repelled by that invisible force before they can touch Caina. They stop in mid-air, then turn around and fly toward Xinghuan at high speeds.

spans.text: Her bullets are once again repelled by that invisible force before they can touch Caina. They stop in mid-air, then turn around and fly toward Xinghuan at high speeds.

units.rawText: Hellbore...
units.displayText: Hellbore...

spans.text: Hellbore...

units.rawText: Enough wasting time already! You're so damn annoying!
units.displayText: Enough wasting time already! You're so damn annoying!

spans.text: Enough wasting time already! You're so damn annoying!

units.rawText: Caina's right hand becomes a huge tentacle which coils around the exo's leg and throws Xinghuan into one of the base's security doors.
units.displayText: Caina's right hand becomes a huge tentacle which coils around the exo's leg and throws Xinghuan into one of the base's security doors.

spans.text: Caina's right hand becomes a huge tentacle which coils around the exo's leg and throws Xinghuan into one of the base's security doors.

units.rawText: Gwaaargh...
units.displayText: Gwaaargh...

spans.text: Gwaaargh...

units.rawText: Let me see what else you have...
units.displayText: Let me see what else you have...

spans.text: Let me see what else you have...

units.rawText: <size=40>HELLBORE CANNON... FIRE!!!</size>
units.displayText: HELLBORE CANNON... FIRE!!!

spans.text: HELLBORE CANNON... FIRE!!!

units.rawText: The Hellbore Cannon fires directly at Caina's head, and the latter easily evades the beam of high-energy operands. Just as she's about to mock Xinghuan, there is an earth-shaking explosion and tongues of flame instantly engulf her surroundings.
units.displayText: The Hellbore Cannon fires directly at Caina's head, and the latter easily evades the beam of high-energy operands. Just as she's about to mock Xinghuan, there is an earth-shaking explosion and tongues of flame instantly engulf her surroundings.

spans.text: The Hellbore Cannon fires directly at Caina's head, and the latter easily evades the beam of high-energy operands. Just as she's about to mock Xinghuan, there is an earth-shaking explosion and tongues of flame instantly engulf her surroundings.

units.rawText: Boom!
units.displayText: Boom!

spans.text: Boom!

units.rawText: <size=40>What the— Gwaaaaargh!</size>
units.displayText: What the— Gwaaaaargh!

spans.text: What the— Gwaaaaargh!

units.rawText: The still-charging spaceship instantly explodes when hit by the Hellbore Cannon and Caina takes the blast square in the face. The powerful shockwave sends Xinghuan flying and sets the entire hangar elevator area ablaze...
units.displayText: The still-charging spaceship instantly explodes when hit by the Hellbore Cannon and Caina takes the blast square in the face. The powerful shockwave sends Xinghuan flying and sets the entire hangar elevator area ablaze...

spans.text: The still-charging spaceship instantly explodes when hit by the Hellbore Cannon and Caina takes the blast square in the face. The powerful shockwave sends Xinghuan flying and sets the entire hangar elevator area ablaze...

units.rawText: ...At last... I got you to move toward the spaceship...
units.displayText: ...At last... I got you to move toward the spaceship...

spans.text: ...At last... I got you to move toward the spaceship...

units.rawText: The fire spreads and the vicious flames lap at Caina's body, but her expression is strangely neutral.
units.displayText: The fire spreads and the vicious flames lap at Caina's body, but her expression is strangely neutral.

spans.text: The fire spreads and the vicious flames lap at Caina's body, but her expression is strangely neutral.

units.rawText: As she watches Xinghuan drag her wounded body back into the base in an attempt to flee, Caina raises her sword amidst the flames, and draws the debris scattered by the fight to its edge, as if magnetized.
units.displayText: As she watches Xinghuan drag her wounded body back into the base in an attempt to flee, Caina raises her sword amidst the flames, and draws the debris scattered by the fight to its edge, as if magnetized.

spans.text: As she watches Xinghuan drag her wounded body back into the base in an attempt to flee, Caina raises her sword amidst the flames, and draws the debris scattered by the fight to its edge, as if magnetized.

units.rawText: The giant blade cleaves like the wind, and the roiling shockwaves churn the air. A dark gale extinguishes the surrounding flames, cleaving the scorched spaceship's remains in twain.
units.displayText: The giant blade cleaves like the wind, and the roiling shockwaves churn the air. A dark gale extinguishes the surrounding flames, cleaving the scorched spaceship's remains in twain.

spans.text: The giant blade cleaves like the wind, and the roiling shockwaves churn the air. A dark gale extinguishes the surrounding flames, cleaving the scorched spaceship's remains in twain.

units.rawText: Caina stands in the middle of the dispersing smoke and looks down at her seared body, her eyes filled with savage bloodlust.
units.displayText: Caina stands in the middle of the dispersing smoke and looks down at her seared body, her eyes filled with savage bloodlust.

spans.text: Caina stands in the middle of the dispersing smoke and looks down at her seared body, her eyes filled with savage bloodlust.

units.rawText: I'm gonna...
units.displayText: I'm gonna...

spans.text: I'm gonna...

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>I'm gonna pulverize your core!</size></color>
units.displayText: I'm gonna pulverize your core!

spans.text: I'm gonna pulverize your core!

units.rawText: Caina laughs maniacally, like she's heard some ridiculous joke.
units.displayText: Caina laughs maniacally, like she's heard some ridiculous joke.

spans.text: Caina laughs maniacally, like she's heard some ridiculous joke.

units.rawText: What, you can't figure it out? Then I'll...
units.displayText: What, you can't figure it out? Then I'll...

spans.text: What, you can't figure it out? Then I'll...

units.rawText: Crack.
units.displayText: Crack.

spans.text: Crack.

units.rawText: Before she can finish speaking, Xinghuan finds herself nailed to the ground. All she saw was a black shadow flashing across her field of vision.
units.displayText: Before she can finish speaking, Xinghuan finds herself nailed to the ground. All she saw was a black shadow flashing across her field of vision.

spans.text: Before she can finish speaking, Xinghuan finds herself nailed to the ground. All she saw was a black shadow flashing across her field of vision.

units.rawText: ...Since when did you have the right to ask me anything?
units.displayText: ...Since when did you have the right to ask me anything?

spans.text: ...Since when did you have the right to ask me anything?

units.rawText: Squelch.
units.displayText: Squelch.

spans.text: Squelch.

units.rawText: Ngh... Aaaaahhhhhhh!!
units.displayText: Ngh... Aaaaahhhhhhh!!

spans.text: Ngh... Aaaaahhhhhhh!!

units.rawText: Caina thrusts her sword into Xinghuan's side and begins twisting the blade. Pain almost seems to obliterate all other sensation as Xinghuan twitches uncontrollably, unable to escape.
units.displayText: Caina thrusts her sword into Xinghuan's side and begins twisting the blade. Pain almost seems to obliterate all other sensation as Xinghuan twitches uncontrollably, unable to escape.

spans.text: Caina thrusts her sword into Xinghuan's side and begins twisting the blade. Pain almost seems to obliterate all other sensation as Xinghuan twitches uncontrollably, unable to escape.

units.rawText: (Groans and gurgles)
units.displayText: Groans and gurgles

spans.text: Groans and gurgles

units.rawText: ...Machine... gun...
units.displayText: ...Machine... gun...

spans.text: ...Machine... gun...

units.rawText: Before the gun can even turn to face Caina, her claws crushes it to bits.
units.displayText: Before the gun can even turn to face Caina, her claws crushes it to bits.

spans.text: Before the gun can even turn to face Caina, her claws crushes it to bits.

units.rawText: Much like a cat on the hunt, she is not above playing with her food. But once her prey angers her, or if she grows bored with it— That's when she does the other thing cats do.
units.displayText:
Much like a cat on the hunt, she is not above playing with her food. But once her prey angers her, or if she grows bored with it—
That's when she does the other thing cats do.

spans.text:
Much like a cat on the hunt, she is not above playing with her food. But once her prey angers her, or if she grows bored with it—
That's when she does the

thing cats do.

units.rawText: Alright then, time to slowly enjoy your death.
units.displayText: Alright then, time to slowly enjoy your death.

spans.text: Alright then, time to slowly enjoy your death.

units.rawText: Caina's right hand transforms into a gigantic tentacle that coils around the exo's leg and throws Xinghuan to the landing pad.
units.displayText: Caina's right hand transforms into a gigantic tentacle that coils around the exo's leg and throws Xinghuan to the landing pad.

spans.text: Caina's right hand transforms into a gigantic tentacle that coils around the exo's leg and throws Xinghuan to the landing pad.

units.rawText: Gwaargh...!
units.displayText: Gwaargh...!

spans.text: Gwaargh...!

units.rawText: The incredible pain leaves Xinghuan almost unable to speak. Even so, Xinghuan struggles to get up, trying to crawl toward one of the spaceships.
units.displayText: The incredible pain leaves Xinghuan almost unable to speak. Even so, Xinghuan struggles to get up, trying to crawl toward one of the spaceships.

spans.text: The incredible pain leaves Xinghuan almost unable to speak. Even so, Xinghuan struggles to get up, trying to crawl toward one of the spaceships.

units.rawText: Crunch.
units.displayText: Crunch.

spans.text: Crunch.

units.rawText: Caina stomps on Xinghuan as she tries to get up and reaches the ship before her.
units.displayText: Caina stomps on Xinghuan as she tries to get up and reaches the ship before her.

spans.text: Caina stomps on Xinghuan as she tries to get up and reaches the ship before her.

units.rawText: Still trying to escape? Then I'll just have to destroy your last hope...
units.displayText: Still trying to escape? Then I'll just have to destroy your last hope...

spans.text: Still trying to escape? Then I'll just have to destroy your last hope...

units.rawText: ...The ship...
units.displayText: ...The ship...

spans.text: ...The ship...

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: ...At last...
units.displayText: ...At last...

spans.text: ...At last...

units.rawText: <color=red>Thrust-vectoring control system damaged&*^)(*_+)</color>
units.displayText: Thrust-vectoring control system damaged&*^)(*_+)

spans.text: Thrust-vectoring control system damaged&*^)(*_+)

units.rawText: <color=red>Oxygen valves damaged&*^)(*_)</color>
units.displayText: Oxygen valves damaged&*^)(*_)

spans.text: Oxygen valves damaged&*^)(*_)

units.rawText: <color=red>GAU-90X Vulcan cannon fire control system damaged&*^)(**)90*)_</color>
units.displayText: GAU-90X Vulcan cannon fire control system damaged&*^)(**)90*)_

spans.text: GAU-90X Vulcan cannon fire control system damaged&*^)(**)90*)_

units.rawText: (Pants) Then why don't you guess where my secret weapon is hidden?
units.displayText: (Pants) Then why don't you guess where my secret weapon is hidden?

spans.text: (Pants) Then why don't you guess where my secret weapon is hidden?

units.rawText: And now...
units.displayText: And now...

spans.text: And now...
